description: This file contains functions for parsing NMEA GPS data such as GPGGA and GPRMC messages. It converts raw GPS strings into structured location data, handles checksum validation, and converts geographic coordinates from degree-minute format to decimal degrees.

methods.name: hex2int
methods.description: Converts a hex string segment to an integer value.

methods.name: str2int
methods.description: Converts a numeric string segment to an integer.

methods.name: gps_deg_dec
methods.description: Converts degrees in DMM format to decimal degrees.

methods.name: gps_convert_deg_to_dec
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude from degrees to decimal format based on directional indicators.

methods.name: str_till_comma
methods.description: Extracts substring till the next comma and converts to float, used in parsing NMEA sentences.

methods.name: nmea_parse_gpgga
methods.description: Parses a GPGGA NMEA sentence and populates a location struct.

methods.name: nmea_parse_gprmc
methods.description: Parses a GPRMC NMEA sentence and populates a location struct, including date/time and speed.

methods.name: nmea_get_message_type
methods.description: Determines the type of NMEA message (GPGGA, GPRMC, or unknown).

methods.name: nmea_valid_checksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of an NMEA message.

methods.name: gps_location
methods.description: Main function to parse GPS data buffer, identify message type, and extract location.
